readerCopy.body: The leader onstage describes a rescue while the people doing the work describe a plan with no budget, staffing, or measurable end. Supporters hold to the hope in the speech; operators point to the missing details that make delivery impossible. The Sun keeps the spotlight on the public figure and promise, while Neptune gives the vision enough emotional force to outrun the record. The opposition forces the inspiring image to face the confusion required to maintain it. The cause may be legitimate, but belief starts to fracture when everyone realizes they were supporting a different version of the promise.
